ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 98% of the visible fluke surface consists of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to isolated localized clusters totaling less than 1% surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform dark-pigmented distribution across the entire surface. Distinct high-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) are localized in the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge, with singular focal white points on the left lobe and lower central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide interior angle (approximately 110-120 degrees); the notch depth is relatively low compared to the overall lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity across the entire boundary. Significant serration and jagged peaks/valleys are visible, particularly on the far-left terminal tip and the right-inner lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve at the inner lobes adjacent to the median notch, transitioning into an irregular convex sweep towards the tips; the left tip exhibits a more vertical, jagged orientation than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of a cluster of 5-6 roughly circular white/light-grey pixel clusters on the right lobe's upper trailing edge; sparse singular clusters detected on the left lobe's dorsal-ventral transition edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical parallel linear pixel disruptions detected in the lower-central region (peduncle-to-fluke transition area).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced structural irregularity and apparent missing tissue segments (notches) on the outer margins of both lobes, suggesting historical physical trauma.
